title: mw.kyc.completed.v1
description: A customer's eKYC matched the Election Commission record (ticket 124, FRS UC-01, DAT-01 kyc.completed): the wallet's KYC level is kycLevel (FULL: exact date of birth and name similarity at or above the threshold; BASIC: date of birth only). Key: walletId. Published once per application through the outbox. Carries no NID, name or date of birth. Consumers: mw-data-export (DW, ticket 128); mw-notify (SMS) and mw-audit-dw (audit) with ticket 124b.

channel.description: APP: the customer onboarded themselves; DSO, AGENT: assisted

matchScorePct.description: Best normalised name similarity (English or Bangla), percent rounded
